rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on back porch overhang) is straightforward property damage to the home.
claim_summary: Four roof shingles blown off back porch overhang by wind with no water intrusion or secondary damage. Estimated repair cost $400. Policyholder has $2,500 deductible, so claim likely does not meet the deductible threshold and may not result in a payout.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off overhang above back porch
